company_name: AVANT GARDE CLEANROOM & ENGG. SOLUTIONS PVT LTD

summary: Avant Garde Cleanroom & Engg. Solutions Pvt Ltd (ACES) is a premium EPC company that delivers turnkey cleanroom and HVAC solutions for semiconductor fabs and advanced technology facilities.
